rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a 2BA/full blastocyst and appropriately notes image quality limits, but it overstates ICM compactness/visibility and speculates on TE/CB range and adverse features not reliably assessable from this image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, endometrium, semen, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status well, though the discussion of DOR versus AMH is somewhat simplified and not deeply tied to embryo-specific prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and generally logical, with conclusions mostly supported by morphology and patient factors; minor tension exists between calling the embryo 2BA and describing it as possibly 2/BB-3BA or BA/CB.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET preference and caution about add-ons; minor overreach appears in detailed prognostic claims and some PGT-A framing.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, and considering PGT-A in context; useful though somewhat general rather than highly case-specific.
